He stops breathing twice in the night and starts again without deciding to. The golden layer and the halo return, the wings stay out after the light goes down, the domain does not want to come back in, and the second pillar is taller than the first and stands longer. He is still ninety-six and nothing moves him. Ring two is Angel's Wing Shield out of a seven-hundred-and-sixty-year Radiant Feather Eagle, it comes back still a bird of prey's shield, and he tests it by standing in the cold spring where it costs him no soul power at all.
